findings.text: the repaired guard asserts a prefix and a suffix where the base asserted equality, so the middle of the reason is unconstrained and any text inserted between the detail clause and the remedy clause passes; the comment above it claims the two clauses pin the whole string, which the loosened assertion no longer establishes.

the section states sixteen listed red ids and then counts thirteen green plus two product defects plus two load-only, which is seventeen, and its own evidence record's class table at docs/evidence/archive/the-suite-is-green-at-head-landed.html:51-54 sums to the same seventeen; the double-counted id is the follower-freshness one, filed in manifest.md:14 under both GREEN 13 and LOAD-ONLY 2 while its head log isolated2/test_follower_freshness.log shows 9 passed.

the Added failures row reads none, but its own paired logs move an id in an owned file from pass to fail: base-logs/test_follower_checks_its_owner.log is 5 passed, exit 0, and isolated2/test_follower_checks_its_owner.log is 1 failed, 4 passed, test_a_reloaded_follower_still_leaves_when_the_original_owner_dies; the row's stated scope covers ids red at base, so its unqualified label overstates what was measured.

the claim that in a quiet serial run each passes is unmeasured for the checks_its_owner id - the run the manifest names as its head is isolated2, one pytest process per file, and there that file is 1 failed, 4 passed; no quiet-serial log showing it green is recorded.

the receipts it names as head are labelled REVISION head-77c20349 - the base sha - and were written before the commit, so a reader resolving their own revision line gets the base tree and no log names the committed head eeaf3bbb.
